First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
40 to 60 miles, climbing; regroups, but treat it as a drop ride. It’s a drop ride: if you can’t hold the pace, you’ll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the RMCC Saturday Fall Road Ride group ride

RMCC Saturday Fall Road Ride is a road group ride in Golden, CO. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Varies. Oct 3: Beverly Heights Park, Golden.

The club’s Saturday road ride through the fall, rotating between Golden, Ken Caryl and Boulder County. Expect 40 to 60 miles with real climbing and an occasional gravel stretch. The group regroups along the way but is a drop ride. Oct 3 is the 51-mile Lookout, Saddleback and Grapevine loop from Beverly Heights Park.
